origin: Walkenhorst Motorsport, born from the passion of Henry Walkenhorst, emerged from the vibrant German club racing scene in the early 2000s. Initially a small, family-run operation focused on BMW endurance racing, the team quickly gained a reputation for meticulous preparation and unwavering dedication. A pivotal moment came in 2007, when, against all odds, they secured a class victory at the Nürburgring 24 Hours, instantly elevating their status and attracting attention from sponsors and talented drivers. This early success fueled the team's growth and ambition, setting the stage for their future endeavors in international GT racing.
philosophy: Walkenhorst Motorsport operates on a foundation of relentless pursuit of performance through data-driven analysis and continuous improvement. Their racing philosophy centers around optimizing car setup for endurance events, prioritizing reliability and consistency over outright pace. While maintaining a professional environment, the team fosters a family-like atmosphere, emphasizing teamwork and mutual respect among drivers and crew members. They believe in nurturing young talent and providing them with opportunities to develop their skills alongside experienced veterans.
achievements: Class victory at the Nürburgring 24 Hours (2007)
Multiple race wins in the VLN Endurance Championship
Podium finishes in various GT World Challenge Europe events
Participation in prestigious endurance races such as the Spa 24 Hours and Bathurst 12 Hour

teamPrincipal.name: Henry Walkenhorst
teamPrincipal.background: Henry Walkenhorst, the founder and driving force behind the team, has an extensive background in motorsport as both a driver and engineer. His hands-on approach and unwavering commitment to excellence have shaped the team's culture and success.

keyFigures.name: Niclas Königbauer
keyFigures.description: Niclas Königbauer is responsible for the technical development and preparation of the team's racing cars. With a background in automotive engineering, he brings a wealth of knowledge and expertise to the team.

headquarters: Walkenhorst Motorsport is based in Melle, Germany, operating from a modest but well-equipped workshop. While the facilities are not extravagant, they provide the necessary tools and resources for the team to maintain and develop their racing cars to a high standard.
fanBase: Walkenhorst Motorsport has cultivated a loyal following among German motorsport enthusiasts, who appreciate their commitment to grassroots racing and their underdog spirit. Fans are drawn to the team's accessible approach and the genuine passion displayed by its members.
